normalAffixes.description: Reduces equipment weight without changing protection.
First legal Martial action each battle costs 1 less AP, minimum 0.
Reduces one fatigue from the first difficult board move.
Raises Support and coordination forecast weight.
Mystic actions generate less enemy target priority.
Adds Crafting while the item is relevant.
Adds Leadership for Union command checks.
Once per round, a meaningful Guard restores 1 Union AP.
Meaningful formation actions gain more mastery.
Raises cleanse forecast weight in relevant states.
Improves damage or work against mission objectives.
Small Treasury XP bonus on civic objectives; capped per contract.
Apprentices gain slightly more valid observation progress.
Improves reliability rather than peak damage.
Reveals one adjacent node after a successful scouting check.
Meaningful history events advance evolution faster.
Reduces Artifact Invocation cooldown by one round, minimum one.
Meaningful Echo use grants more Resonance.
Invocation MP cost reduced by 1, minimum 1.
Improves morale recovery after a safe victory.
Improves survival against visible boss telegraphs.
Reduces one class of environmental hazard.
Meaningful paired actions grant slightly more trust.
Reduces injury risk in approved training content.
First shield Art costs 1 less AP.
Reduces Mystic backlash on mixed outcomes.
Prepared mixtures have a small chance not to consume a charge.
Respected mentorship improves cultural Art learning.
Responsible Abyss reporting grants small sustainability progress.

rareAffixes.description: Once per battle, may replace a legal action with an intercept when an ally would be incapacitated.
Once per battle, recovering from low Cohesion restores 2 AP.
After formation break, the wielder becomes less exposed instead of more.
A valid adjacent apprentice gains additional proficiency from the wielder’s meaningful action.
Protection objectives can add an item-history evolution mark.
Enables one compatible hybrid Art family when all normal prerequisites are met.
Once per expedition, ignore a route-locking hazard after a successful check.
A Support forecast may transfer up to 2 MP between consenting Union members.
A visible boss telegraph may produce a preemptive barrier forecast.
Ranged special shots do not require separate ammunition bookkeeping.
Nonlethal resolution increases reputation and relationship rewards.
Adds one additional legal forecast family when leader knowledge conditions are met.
At camp, may trigger a positive history conversation instead of a generic recovery beat.
One meaningful hybrid action grants partial progress to both relevant disciplines.
Rescue forecasts can stabilize two targets at higher AP cost.
Unlocks a specialized objective forecast from compatible tools.
First coordinated multi-Union command costs 1 less AP per involved Union.
At low MP, the simulation favors legal conserving actions without suppressing emergency healing.
Once per expedition, reroll one die after seeing a noncritical failure; committed result becomes permanent.
Meaningful repairs may reveal an evolution recipe.
Guard actions can prepare a defensive Invocation forecast.
Marked targets improve compatible Echo targeting.
Meaningful healing can reduce an Invocation cooldown.
Objective reveals improve control-Echo behavior.
Chosen-equipment rejection causes no item loss and records a future quest hook.
First formation switch retains part of prior formation mastery bonuses.
A portion of item sale value can be directed into a named Guild Hall project for bonus reputation.
Reveals one additional lawful option in gate anomaly events.
Late-bloomer recruits gain more meaningful mastery, but no immediate stat bonus.
Rare history events contribute more strongly toward Emergent Legend review.

abyssAffixes.description: Meaningful ally protection records a Mud Trenches history mark.
Improves defense against visible ranged barrages.
After a safe camp, recover one additional supply if the expedition helped another team.
Collapsed-wall objectives yield extra civic repair material.
Nonlethal victories recover more morale.
Improves formation Cohesion while not flanked.
A successful Guard can remove one minor corruption effect.
Improves ethical creature handling; damage against nonhostile creatures is penalized.
The simulation penalizes forecasts that abandon a controllable ally.
Protection of civilians accelerates item evolution and Aegis clue progress.
Displays clearer Abyss sustainability feedback.
Warns one expedition earlier before a farming penalty escalates.
Records the first clear and unlocks one cosmetic history mark.
Approved beginner training has reduced injury severity.
Protecting an ally can reveal an emergency extraction option.
Raises legal boss-interruption forecast weight.
Records summon-clue research; does not summon or own a Great Summon.
Reveals one extra optional branch on a previously cleared floor.
Civic extraction and mapping gain more sustainability.
Item temporarily loses a behavioral bonus during exploitative repeat farming.
Preserves one lore fragment in item history.
Confirms the item interacts with Abyss manifestations, never stolen individual souls.
Can unlock a Guild Hall/public works blueprint on first responsible use.
Long-term stewardship marker; no ownership claim over the Abyss.
